description: SPEC §1.4 cohorts: every fixture installation's cohort under one rollout's salt, how many are in the candidate at each percentage, and boundary and cohort-key vectors. Computed by runtimes/testdata/gen/generate.py, which is none of the runtimes

vectors.note: the lowest cohort: in the candidate from 1 %
the highest cohort: in the candidate only at 100 %
the first installation under another rollout's salt
a Go per-request cohort key: any non-empty string, hashed as UTF-8
a non-ASCII cohort key: its UTF-8 bytes
NFD is not NFC: keys are not normalized
